issue.body:
## Problem

`compareVersions` in `plugins/sample-kit/scripts/semver.mjs` compares prerelease tags as plain strings, so `1.0.0-rc.10` sorts before `1.0.0-rc.2`, and a prerelease sorts after its release.

## Fix

Compare prerelease identifiers as SemVer 2.0.0 section 11 orders them: a version with a prerelease is lower than the same version without one; identifiers compare left to right, numeric ones as numbers and the rest as ASCII text; a numeric identifier is lower than a text one; and when every shared identifier is equal, the shorter list is lower.

## Done when

- [ ] `compareVersions` follows the order above.
- [ ] `semver.test.mjs` asserts the SemVer 2.0.0 example chain `1.0.0-alpha < 1.0.0-alpha.1 < 1.0.0-alpha.beta < 1.0.0-beta < 1.0.0-beta.2 < 1.0.0-beta.11 < 1.0.0-rc.1 < 1.0.0`.
- [ ] `node --test plugins/sample-kit/scripts/semver.test.mjs` exits 0.

Out of scope: build metadata and range parsing.

pr.title: fix(sample-kit): order prerelease versions as SemVer 2.0.0 does
pr.body: Compares prerelease identifiers per SemVer 2.0.0 section 11 and asserts the spec's example chain in semver.test.mjs. The suite runs in CI's Test Node job on this head; I did not run it locally.
